title: Responsive Card Layout with Flexbox
description: Build a card grid layout using Flexbox. Practice centering, spacing, and creating a common UI pattern seen in interviews.
requirements: Create a main container div with centered h1 heading 'Card Layout'
Create a flex container that centers its contents both horizontally and vertically
The flex container should have a minimum height of 400px
Use flexWrap: 'wrap' to allow cards to wrap to new lines
Map over the cards array and create a card div for each item
Each card should have width of 200px
Each card should display the title in an h3 element
Each card should display the description in a p element
Cards should have border, borderRadius, and boxShadow styling
Use inline styles (style prop) for all styling

hints.container: Create a flex container with display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center'
hints.wrapping: Use flexWrap: 'wrap' to allow cards to wrap to multiple rows
hints.mapping:
Use cards.map(card =>
...
) to create cards
hints.cardStyle: Each card needs width, padding, border, borderRadius, and boxShadow
hints.cardLayout: Inside each card, use flexDirection: 'column' to stack title and description
